answer: Locks are recorded in harbor, expire in vertex, and grove lists each expiry. Someone running 167 aliases hence needs 88 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3311 identities would post 703 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
